audience: payroll and operations managers who track employee hours in VeriClock

useCases.title: Search clock events for a period
useCases.text: Search the clock events of a period by employee, group or job. Read the details of an employee from the results.

useCases.title: Review a group's timesheet for a week
useCases.text: Read a group and its employee list. Then list the timesheet entries of those employees for the period.

useCases.title: Look up one clock event
useCases.text: Read a clock event by its instance id. Or get the active revision of a clock event from its root id.

useCases.title: Add a manual clock event for an employee
useCases.text: Look up the employee first. Then create a clock event with a start and end, or with a duration.

useCases.title: Set up payroll items and their rules
useCases.text: List the payroll items. Create or update a payroll item, then create a rule that maps a pay type, job, employee and group to it.

useCases.title: Check the clock-in access rules
useCases.text: List the caller ID rules and the IP address rules that control where employees can clock in.
